title: The square root of 2 is irrational
prose: Theorem. The square root of 2 is not rational. Proof. Suppose √2 = p/q with p, q coprime integers. Then 2q² = p², so p² is even, hence p = 2r for some integer r. Substituting, 2q² = 4r², so q² = 2r² is even — but then p and q are both even, contradicting coprimality.
